source_inspiration.notes: Used as demand research only: users want help assembling detailed image prompts. No third-party prompt text was copied.

pathforge_fit_adaptation: Adapted the demand into a local studio where users compose an image-prompt ingredient card, balance subject/style/composition/lighting/detail sliders, preview a readable card, and copy/export the card without calling an AI or image-generation service.

Final artifact is a self-contained HTML studio under public/artifacts with localStorage, copy, and text download flows.

steps.prompt_exact: I need a small self-contained visual prompt ingredient studio I can save as an HTML file, where I can balance subject, lighting, style, and composition with sliders, preview an image-prompt ingredient card, and copy or export it before pasting into an image model.
steps.response_summary: Returned a complete self-contained HTML visual prompt ingredient studio with sliders, chips, preview card, copy, download, local storage, and sample data.

code_blocks.code:
Visual Prompt Ingredient Studio

Balance subject, lighting, style, and composition into a clean image prompt card you can copy into any image model. Everything stays local.

Prompt ingredients

Subject focus 70
Higher means the prompt centers more strongly on the main subject.
Lighting drama 55
Low is soft and even. High is directional, contrasty, and cinematic.
Style intensity 45
Controls whether style is subtle support or a dominant visual language.
Composition control 60
Higher adds more specific framing, lens, and layout instructions.

Ingredient card preview

weathered astronaut botanist
Balance score
Prompt density
Local only. No APIs, tracking, fonts, or external assets.
Mobile-first layout
Offline save-friendly
Prompt balance scoring
Copy and export workflow
